source_reasoning: store.mjs:429-453 rejects events without id, nonmatching/subagent user roots, unknown parents, and subagent terminals. Each non-root event requires a previously observed parent; unknown-parent events are discarded, not re-evaluated.
store.mjs:537-552 observes every SDK callback before diagnostic projection; only four event types are captured, without parentId/agentId/ephemeral.
store.mjs:553-557 and606-623 wait on completion.done before the next claim. completion-wait is an unbounded cancellable wait, not receive-held; no UI hold diagnostic is expected from that wait.

Therefore an idle callback can be logged yet rejected as completion. The available projection cannot distinguish missing ancestry, reordered callbacks, subagent filtering, or missing root correlation.
